final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Employee GROUP BY ReportsTo), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS total FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.ReportsTo, s1.n, CAST(s1.n AS REAL) / s2.total AS share FROM s1 CROSS JOIN s2 WHERE s2.total IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s3) SELECT s3.ReportsTo, s3.n, s3.share, s3.share - s4.avg_share FROM s3 CROSS JOIN s4 WHERE s4.avg_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s3.share - s4.avg_share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
